agenda_text:
NOTICE!
City of Inglewood Parking
 and Traffic Commission

  NOTICE OF MEETING
  POSTPONEMENT

 Notice is hereby notified that the Parking and
 Traffic Commission meeting is not scheduled
for November 2019 and December 2019 due to
  public holidays and city closures.

The next scheduled meeting date is:
January 22nd, 2020
